Name: Cow Diversity
Author: daedreamexe
Description:
If you have any questions, feel free to dm me on [url=https://www.instagram.com/daedream.exe/]instagram[/url]! And if you like this mod, consider endorsing it or donating/buying me a [url=https://ko-fi.com/daedream_exe]ko-fi[/url]﻿ :))

[size=3][b][u]INSTRUCTIONS
[/u][/b][/size]
[b]1.   [/b]Download and [b]unzip/extract.[/b] Move to Stardew Valley mods folder.
[b]2.   [/b]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and/or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿ depending on the mod version you download.
       ﻿[b] →[/b] the AT version requires SMAPI and Alternative Textures
[b]        →[/b] the CP version requires SMAPI and Content Patcher
[b]
[/b]The AT and CP versions are compatible, so both can be downloaded at once.
[b]RE-DOWNLOAD IF YOU HAVE THE 1.0.0 VERSION![/b][b] I added an update key to the 1.0.1 version that would notify you about further updates![/b][b]

~~~

[/b][size=3][b][u]MOD VERSIONS EXPLAINED
[/u]
[/b][b]1. CONTENT PATCHER VERSION
[/b]
﻿[/size][b] → [/b]the CP version will automatically [u]replace all cow textures[/u], for both old and new cows
[b] → [/b][u]only one texture for each cow type[/u] (white/brown cow), which look like the vanilla Stardew Valley white/brown cows
[b] → [/b]you can change the cow textures I chose to another one by following the instructions in the 'customization tips.txt' file I left if you want!

[b][size=3]2. ALTERNATIVE TEXTURES VERSION[/size]

[/b]﻿[b] →  [/b]the AT version will [u]automatically and randomly choose a cow texture for any new cows[/u], and Marnie's cows
﻿[b] →  [/b]for cows you already bought, or for cows you don't like the randomly chosen texture, you have to [u]buy a pair of scissors from Robin[/u], and use it on cows [u]to manually change their texture[/u]
﻿[b] →[/b]  ﻿[u]all cows available at once[/u]

Downloads.Description: Alternative Textures version. all cow variations available for both white and brown cows.

Manifest.Name: (AT) daedream.exe's Cow Diversity
Manifest.Description: 27 different cow variations for Alternative Textures. Variations include 2 base game inspired cows, 9 breed-based cows, 9 solid colored cows, and 7 solid colored highland cows.
Manifest.Author: daedreamexe

Downloads.Description: Content Patcher version. the default cows look like the vanilla Stardew Valley cows. replacement files of all the other cows included, with a customization guide as well.

Manifest.Name: (CP) daedream.exe's Cow Diversity
Manifest.Description: The Cow Diversity mod, but using Content Patcher to replace the default cows.
Manifest.Author: daedreamexe
